what: A small glass ruler floating beside a long pinned section — inside a 22×184 panel stand 21 ticks in all, five thick ones with four faint (.3) ticks between each, and an accent-colored needle moves down 0 → 164px with section progress (when the section top touches the top of the screen → when the section end touches the bottom of the screen). Tick i narrows in width 1 → .45 → 1 (ease-in-out) within a ±15% range centered on progress i×5%, and a wave flows around the needle.

options.trigger: Section CSS used to measure progress (default nearest section)
options.travel: Distance the needle drops in px, default 164
options.wave: Half-width of tick wave (progress ratio), default .15
options.squeeze: Horizontal scale of the center wave ticks, default .45
options.--fx-rung · --fx-needle: Tick and needle colors (default var(--kf-contrast-ink) · var(--kf-accent))

from.where: index.html .vb-ladder left of the 3D stage·scroll film — original ScrollLadder (view-timeline contain, ladderTrack 0→164px, ladderWave range i×5% ±15%)

note: If the part element is empty, ticks and a needle are created and inserted. Position (left center, etc.) is set by the using side’s css — the part gives only size and a glass pane
